**metrics:** `pixel search-content` no longer reports a context saving on output a native search prints as well. Its baseline was one assumed 4 KiB read per matched file, which showed 81% to 96% saved on answers `rg` returns byte for byte; it is now the answer itself, and the row reads `a native search returns the same output, N tok (no saving)`. Records move to `workflow-v3`; `pixel token-savings` totals for searches drop accordingly.
